therapeutic_hypothesis.compound: Sirolimus, Tacrolimus, Thymoglobulin, and Rituximab combination
therapeutic_hypothesis.claimed_target: T-cell activation, B-cell depletion, calcineurin pathway, mTOR pathway
therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Multi-modal immunosuppression combining calcineurin inhibition, mTOR inhibition, T-cell depletion, and B-cell depletion
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Prevention of graft-versus-host disease through comprehensive immune suppression
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Patients undergoing haploidentical and HLA partially matched donor hematopoietic cell transplantation
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Incidence and severity of acute graft-versus-host disease during first six months post transplant

results.dose_information: Sirolimus: 12 mg loading dose day -3, then 4 mg daily (target 3-12 ng/ml); Tacrolimus: 0.03 mg/kg IV q24h starting day -3, then oral at 4x IV dose; Thymoglobulin: infused over 6 hours first dose, 4 hours subsequent doses; Rituximab: 28 mg/kg total (14 mg/kg on days -7 and +3)

context.duration: Six months primary follow-up, two years for chronic GVHD assessment
